title: What fills the signed-in person's home: known caches, build directories, Trash, workspaces and agent history
description: GET and POST /api/v1/account/storage/breakdown. The person's daemon measures a fixed list of places in their own home, without following symbolic links or crossing mounts, and keeps only the latest result in memory. GET returns it and starts a new measurement when there is none or it is over 15 minutes old; POST asks for one now. A measurement never blocks the reply: while it runs, the reply carries the previous result with measuring true. Nothing here removes anything; clean-up is the agent's, at the person's request.

group.description: caches: a tool's regenerable cache. finished: a build directory in a worktree whose Taskfleet run has ended, or a merged worktree no run holds. live: a build directory in a worktree a Taskfleet run still holds, or whose run state could not be read. own: a build directory in a workspace's own checkout or in a worktree no run names. trash, workspaces (a workspace folder under ~/src without the build directories listed separately) and history (agent conversations) are shown, not offered for clean-up.

kind.description: cache-tag is a ~/.cache directory marked with a standard CACHEDIR.TAG. target is a Cargo build directory (it carries Cargo's CACHEDIR.TAG); node_modules sits beside a package.json.

path.description: Below the person's home, starting with ~/. Never an absolute path.

bytes.description: Allocated size (st_blocks), each hard-linked file counted once in a measurement.

complete.description: False when the walk hit its time or entry bound, or a part could not be read; bytes is then a lower bound.

workspace.description: The workspace folder under ~/src the item belongs to, for build directories and workspaces.

run_id.description: The Taskfleet run that holds or held the worktree.

merged.description: The worktree's branch is merged; set on finished items no run names.

measuring.description: A measurement is running now; items are the previous result, or empty before the first.

measured_at.description: When the result in items finished. Absent before the first measurement.

complete.description: False when some place could not be measured in full or the list of worktrees was incomplete.
